surface_name: Google Email app, Watch emails trigger
title: New Gmail watch scenario processes hundreds of old emails on first activation
symptoms: The first runs after activation act on historical emails
A burst of notices goes out the moment the scenario is turned on
cause: The watch trigger starts from the oldest matching email unless a starting point is chosen before activation.
fix: Before turning the scenario on, set the trigger's starting point to From now on.
apply: Make editor: right-click the trigger module > Choose where to start > From now on > OK, then switch Scheduling on.
affected: Make Google Email app, Watch emails, June 2026
